# Close wrap — Mon 2026-11-23 (~4:35 PM ET)

**Indexes:** S&P 500 +4.73% to 7,237.17; Nasdaq +6.51% to 24,089.56; Dow +1,447.98 (+3.01%) to 49,595.31. Best day since April 2025 for the S&P and Nasdaq, closing near session highs, the session after all three ended Friday in correction ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/11/22/stock-market-today-live-updates.html), [RTTNews](https://www.rttnews.com/3717253/tech-shares-fuel-rebound-in-u-s-stocks.aspx?type=uscom)).

**Why:** Nvidia's board reinstated Jensen Huang as CEO, and NVDA closed +31% ([Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/live/stock-market-today-monday-november-23-dow-sp-500-nasdaq-surge-after-nvidia-reinstates-jensen-huang-182039397.html)). Tech and semis led the gains. CRWD/ZS deal: see the pre-market brief.

**Covered holds:** TGT C $168.28 (+1.48%) ([exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stocks/TGT)); TJX C $139.02 (−0.43%) ([Finviz](https://finviz.com/stock?t=TJX)); COST C $1,097.91 (−0.38%), with the ex-div exit due today ([exa](https://exa.ai/library/markets/stocks/COST)).

**After hours:** HPE −2.4% even though Q4 adj EPS of $1.43 on $14.5B revenue and FY27 guidance of EPS $5.05–5.35 and sales $59.4–63.1B both topped estimates (vs $4.76 and $55.1B) ([Seeking Alpha](https://seekingalpha.com/news/4675761-hpe-falls-even-as-q4-results-guidance-top-estimates-by-wide-margin)). Agilent Q4 adj EPS $1.86 vs $1.73 est, sales $2.04B vs $1.988B ([Benzinga](https://www.benzinga.com/news/earnings/26/11/63563526/agilent-technologies-q4-adj-eps-1-86-beats-1-73-estimate-sales-2-040b-beat-1-988b-estimate)). ZM: no verified reaction yet.

**Setup for tomorrow:** consumer confidence at 10:00; ADI, BBY, MDT and DLTR report BMO; DELL, HPQ, ADSK and WDAY report AMC (AI-server read for the avoid re-review 11/25). PCE, GDP and claims land Wed at 8:30, with a December hike ~96% priced.

## Swing ideas
- **A (Agilent), CONDITIONAL:** log at the 11/24 close only if the post-beat gain holds. Reason: clean EPS and sales beat in non-tech (the beat-drift lesson). Confidence: low. Key risk: the FY guide is unverified, and a hot PCE on Wed.
- **No other new longs.** We don't chase the AI squeeze (gaps >5% the session after a shock); the AI-hardware avoid holds to the 11/25 review.
